Variants.Content: Heart's Home lies in the Vale and is a major lordly seat of House Corbray. Its poetic name easily leads outsiders to picture a quiet knightly manor, yet quiet in the Vale always comes with conditions: the mountain roads must be open, the granaries full, and the neighboring clans temporarily kept from coming down the hills. Castle and hall sustain a whole web of local relations—squires, farmhands, knights, caravans, marriages, and debts all intersect here. It is drawn by the legal authority of the Eyrie while also touching the wider Seven Kingdoms through the High Road and inland routes. Under any banner, Heart's Home is first and foremost a Vale lordship that requires water, grain, roads, and credit to endure; those conditions outlast temporary political declarations.

Entry Heart's Home If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

The artisans of Heart's Home leave their craft in stone walls, wooden beams, iron gates, crypts, and the seams left by generations of repairs, while priests explain life and death through chapels of the Seven, the threat of the mountain clans, and Andal knightly tradition. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Heart's Home They care about goats, thin fields, orchards, and pack teams crossing the Mingyue Mountains. They also look at whether seeds are left after collecting grain, and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
